name: write_report
description: Write a new report to research/reports/ or append an amendment to an existing one. Handles file naming, required section anchors (Executive Summary, Recommendations, Open Questions, Sources), README update, and TOPICS.md status change. Mutating — requires human confirmation before writing.

name.description: Report name in kebab-case (e.g. 'skillnet-integration'). Used as the filename.

title.description: Full human-readable title for the frontmatter blockquote.

confidence.description: Confidence level with method (e.g. 'High (primary sources)', 'Medium (docs + inference)').

executive_summary.description: 2–4 sentence executive summary of the report's conclusions.

body.description: Full markdown body of the report — theme sections, evidence, analysis. Do not include Executive Summary, Recommendations, Open Questions, or Sources sections; those are generated from the other fields.

recommendations.description: Actionable recommendations. Each becomes a subsection under ## Recommendations.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions or gaps identified during research. Each becomes a bullet under ## Open Questions.

sources.description: Source URLs or file references with '— fetched YYYY-MM-DD' suffix.

concept_references.description: Kebab slugs of concept files this report references (for bidirectional linking). Optional.

amend.description: If true, append an Amendment section to an existing file.

examples.description: Write a new integration recommendation report

input.name: hermes-skills-for-akh
input.title: Adopting Hermes skills_guard.py for AKH Trust Pipeline
input.executive_summary: Hermes's skills_guard.py implements the most complete open-source skill security scanner available. AKH should adopt its 6-category threat model and trust-level install policy.
input.body:
## Current AKH Gap

AKH has no security scan at install time...

recommendations.title: Import skills_guard.py as AKH's install-time scanner
recommendations.detail: Fork or vendor NousResearch/hermes-agent tools/skills_guard.py. Wire it into the AKH submission pipeline at the point a skill SKILL.md is received.

open_questions: Does SLAC's security team need to review the regex patterns before adoption?
Should the install policy for SLAC-internal skills use 'trusted' or 'community' trust level?
